(rule!
  ;; The command cell controls how the right 3x3 occupancy mask is aligned.
  (letrec ((apply-command
            (lambda (grid cmd)
              (cond [(= cmd 1) grid]
                    [(= cmd 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
                    [(= cmd 3) (flip-lr grid)]
                    [else (rotate-180 grid)]))))
    ;; The two motifs occupy columns 0..2 and 4..6 below the command row.
    (let* ((cmd (at g 0 3))
           (left (subgrid g 1 0 3 2))
           (right (apply-command (subgrid g 1 4 3 6) cmd)))
      ;; Colors inside the motifs are irrelevant: cyan marks occupancy overlap.
      (grid-from-fn 3 3
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (and (not (zero? (at left r c)))
                   (not (zero? (at right r c))))
              8
              0))))))
